name: 리콜 · 저승길 차림
eyes: 매의 눈처럼 빛나는 밝은 노란색 눈
outfit: 회청색(#74849c) 두건과 짧은 망토, 가죽 토시
silhouette: 회청색 두건을 쓴 작은 체구, 머리 크기만한 거대한 매의 실루엣, 팔에 매달린 깃털 뭉치, 짧은 망토
signature_motion: 대시할 때 매가 날아오르며 전방으로 돌진함
signature_vfx: 매의 날갯짓을 따라 흩날리는 밝은 황금색 깃털 잔상
visual_en: A small 2-unit ratio hunter wearing a muted blue-grey (#74849 cloth) hood and a short cape. His eyes shine with a bright, piercing golden yellow (#FFD700) that stands out in the dark. On his arm, covered by a thick brown leather bracer, sits a massive hawk, nearly as large as his head, featuring distinct cream and dark brown feathers. He wears rugged earth-toned leather gear and sturdy boots. The hawk's large silhouette and bright eye-catching yellow accents on the hunter's face and the hawk's talons provide high visibility against dark backgrounds.
features_en: Human face with a small nose and mouth under the hood
Plain blue-grey cloth hood without any pattern
Small brown-and-cream hawk perched on the forearm

Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing alert with a focused gaze, ready to command the hawk.
vfx_en: A few brown and cream feathers scattering and drifting in the air.
motion_en: The hawk soars forward during a dash, leading the hunter's path.
lore: 매사냥꾼 영웅. 매가 함께 싸운다 — 탄이 늘 조금씩 휘어 적을 찾아간다. 대시할 때마다 매가 날아올라 함께 앞으로 나간다. 무한 모드를 완주하면 열리는 영웅.
